home.subtitle: Select desired settings and start cropping:
anki.description: ScanLingua support Anki integration via Anki-connect.
anki.cardInfo: Seamlessly export general or single character cards to selected deck. Exported cards are preset in "Cloze" type with #scanlingua hashtag.
anki.enableAddon: To use this function you need to enable Anki-connect add-on:
anki.limitation: Card export works only with Anki app running on background, due to chrome API limitations, audio cannot be exported.
about.description: ScanLingua provides Japanese, Chinese and Korean text recognition of selected screen areas with translation, annotation and audio.
about.security: Extension is secure by design and don't rely on any external services exept for free native chrome APIs for audio and translation.
about.ocrEngine: Text recognition is powered by local engine - Baidu's PaggleOCR (PP-OCRv5).
about.dictionaries: Characters annotation uses the following local english dictionaries, licensed under 'CC BY-SA 4.0': KANJIDIC2, CC-CEDICT, CC-KEDICT.
support.help: If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please open an issue on <github>GitHub</github> or contact me directly via links in the footer.
support.ratePrompt: If you find this extension helpful, please take a moment and rate it:
overlay.noTextHint: No text detected. Try to crop larger text portion.
overlay.textNotDetectedHint: Text not detected. Try to crop a larger text portion.
tts.installVoiceMac: Install a {{langName}} voice: System Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content > System Voice > Manage Voices
tts.installVoiceWindows: Install a {{langName}} voice: Settings > Time & Language > Speech > Manage voices > Add voices
tts.installVoiceChromeOS: Install a {{langName}} voice: Settings > Accessibility > Text-to-Speech > Speech Engines
notification.langPairNotAvailable: Language pair not available, switched to English
notification.cardNotAdded: Card not Added. See instruction in "Anki export" tab.
notification.cardAdded: Card succesfully added to selected deck.
notification.kanjiCardAdded: Kanji card succesfully added to selected deck.
notification.mainCardAdded: Main info card succesfully added to selected deck
notification.ankiNotRunning: Anki is not running. Launch Anki and try again.
